upstream.description: Steno is the highly secure privacy-first AI notepad & notetaker for all your confidential conversations. On Windows & MacOS. For government and defence sectors.

classification.analysis: Steno (stenoai) is a privacy-first, 100% on-device macOS (and alpha Windows) desktop app that records, live-transcribes with speaker labels, summarizes, and lets you query meetings using local AI models (Parakeet TDT v3 for live transcription, Whisper for other languages, Gemma/Qwen via Ollama for summarization), with no cloud dependency by default. It supports auto-detecting meeting start/stop, system audio capture without Screen Recording permission, Markdown export, Obsidian sync, custom report templates, and optional bring-your-own-cloud-model (OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock), plus agent skills (`/steno`, `granola-to-steno`) for querying notes from Claude Code. It targets government, defense, legal, healthcare, and privacy-conscious professionals who need confidential meeting notes that never leave their machine.

use_cases.title: Record and transcribe confidential meetings entirely on-device
Ask natural-language questions across your meeting history
Sync meeting notes into an Obsidian vault as Markdown
Query Steno meeting notes from Claude Code via the /steno agent skill
